packageRules.description: Base images are pinned by digest, so a rebuilt tag reaches the image only through this update. The shared preset takes Dockerfile updates before 6am on Monday, and the Renovate cron does not reach every repository inside that window, so a digest could sit stale for weeks and hold back an OS fix the Trivy gate then trips on. Digests keep the three-day age and automerge, in their own group so a tag bump never shares their branch.

A FROM added later with a bare tag gets its digest pin from Renovate rather than from someone remembering to add one. The digest rule above only matches references that are already pinned. Scoped to the FROM dep types: without it the pin also lands on the `# syntax=` directive in site/Dockerfile, which is meant to float on docker/dockerfile:1.

rand_core is a dev-dependency only because rsa 0.9 wants an rng from it, and rsa 0.9 is pinned to the rand_core 0.6 API: 0.9+ does not compile against it. Hold until rsa releases on the new rand_core, then drop this rule. See LFSX#307 and LFSX#317.

tracing-opentelemetry pins the opentelemetry minor it bridges to, so bumping either side alone leaves two opentelemetry versions in the graph and SdkTracer stops satisfying the Tracer bound the layer needs (#447). One branch for the family and the bridge, so whatever is released together is judged together by CI. If the family moves ahead of the bridge the branch goes red rather than merging, and that red is the signal to wait for the bridge.

TypeScript 7 is outside Angular's supported range: @angular/compiler-cli 22 declares `typescript: >=6.0 <6.1`, and the compiler errors out rather than warns on an unsupported version. Hold at 6.x until Angular ships support, then drop this rule. See FerrLabs/.github#313.
